name: v2-linear-delta-one-move
covers: Linear delta tower motion and nonzero initial positions
review: With 250 mm arms, 124 mm tower radius, tower angles 210/330/90 degrees and 80 steps/mm, independent sphere geometry predicts all ten equally spaced block-end tower positions within 0.50 step of the recorded positions; the initial position is 17366.45 steps per tower. For a 1 mm zero-to-zero move at 100 mm/s^2 and 10 mm/s maximum speed, continuous acceleration reaches 10 mm/s at the midpoint and takes 0.2 s. The ten segment durations agree with successive square-root velocity boundaries within 0.15%; the recorded total is about 0.20005 s. Homing is disabled to isolate motion. This does not independently validate discrete pulse timing or physical hardware.
